tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for running text and forms.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Panels and quiet areas: a barely tinted neutral. Never for cards that sit on bg-hero.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: What floats: menus, dialogs, popovers. In light it relies on border-subtle and shadow-float to separate from bg.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected row, ghost button hover, skeleton. 4.5:1 for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: bg-hero
tokens.usage: Hero and closing CTA bands. Text on it uses on-hero and on-hero-muted.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on bg-hero (16.5:1 light, 18:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and small print on bg-hero (11:1 light).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, surface-tint and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-heading
tokens.usage: Headings h1–h4 on bg and surface tokens. The brand blue carries the identity in light mode.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text, metadata, footer links (7.7:1 light, 9.2:1 dark on bg).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline that separates things. Decorative only: never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Border of a control (secondary button, input, checkbox): 3:1 on bg, surface-tint and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Identity colour for illustrations, cover blocks and the selected nav underline. Use ink-heading for text.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Identity accent for decorative marks, the active step dot and highlights on bg-hero. Never carries body text or white text.

tokens.name: on-brand-orange
tokens.usage: Text or digits on brand-orange, such as the current step dot (5.8:1 light).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, text buttons and secondary button outline (8.9:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button per view. Light uses a deepened orange so white label text passes 4.6:1.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action. Dark mode switches to near-black because the brighter orange is too light for white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed page behind a dialog or sheet.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations and completed states. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings such as an expiring session or files that are out of date.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed stages, destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on the filled danger button of a confirming step.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts and the invalid input fill.

tokens.name: label-1
tokens.usage: Annotation label 1 (blue): chip text, icon and highlight underline. At least 4.9:1 on its -soft pair and on surface-raised. Always shown with the label's name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: label-1-soft
tokens.usage: Annotation label 1 (blue): background of highlighted text and of the label chip. ink on it is at least 11:1.

tokens.name: label-2
tokens.usage: Annotation label 2 (violet): chip text, icon and highlight underline. At least 4.9:1 on its -soft pair and on surface-raised. Always shown with the label's name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: label-2-soft
tokens.usage: Annotation label 2 (violet): background of highlighted text and of the label chip. ink on it is at least 11:1.

tokens.name: label-3
tokens.usage: Annotation label 3 (teal): chip text, icon and highlight underline. At least 4.9:1 on its -soft pair and on surface-raised. Always shown with the label's name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: label-3-soft
tokens.usage: Annotation label 3 (teal): background of highlighted text and of the label chip. ink on it is at least 11:1.

tokens.name: label-4
tokens.usage: Annotation label 4 (magenta): chip text, icon and highlight underline. At least 4.9:1 on its -soft pair and on surface-raised. Always shown with the label's name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: label-4-soft
tokens.usage: Annotation label 4 (magenta): background of highlighted text and of the label chip. ink on it is at least 11:1.

tokens.name: label-5
tokens.usage: Annotation label 5 (amber): chip text, icon and highlight underline. At least 4.9:1 on its -soft pair and on surface-raised. Always shown with the label's name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: label-5-soft
tokens.usage: Annotation label 5 (amber): background of highlighted text and of the label chip. ink on it is at least 11:1.

tokens.name: label-6
tokens.usage: Annotation label 6 (green): chip text, icon and highlight underline. At least 4.9:1 on its -soft pair and on surface-raised. Always shown with the label's name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: label-6-soft
tokens.usage: Annotation label 6 (green): background of highlighted text and of the label chip. ink on it is at least 11:1.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: The page title, once per page. ink-heading. Utility: text-title.

styles.name: app-section
styles.usage: Section and dialog titles. ink-heading. Utility: text-section.

styles.name: app-body
styles.sample: Each project keeps its documents, configuration and records.
styles.usage: Default text, controls, table cells. Tabular figures on. Utility: text-body.

styles.name: app-small
styles.usage: Labels, helper text, secondary facts. Utility: text-small.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. Below 600px: 36px / 40px.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Select, convert and index in one run
styles.usage: Page title when the page has no hero. Below 600px: 32px / 38px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Accordion questions, footer column titles, form section titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Find documents in Confluence or SharePoint, convert them to Markdown and index them for search.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero or h1. Max 60ch. Below 600px: 18px / 28px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each stage runs on every selected file. You can proceed when all of them are done.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Supports PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML and Markdown.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, helper text, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, legal small print, timestamps. Never below 13px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and eyebrow labels above section headings (eyebrows uppercase, +0.06em).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and nav labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: File counts and key figures. Always tabular numerals.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Run ids, file hashes and request ids, grouped in fours.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to input; gap between stacked buttons on mobile.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; grid gap below 600px; heading to paragraph.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap 600–959px; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop grid gap; card padding at 960px and up; tablet side gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (960px and up).

spacing.note: App working steps: space-2 (8), space-3 (12), space-4 (16), space-6 (24). The larger steps are for website sections.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: App: buttons, fields, checkboxes, tabs, menu items. Utility: rounded-control.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: App: panels, dialogs, menus, toasts. Utility: rounded-panel. Also what rounded-md to rounded-4xl map to.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts. Website only: the app has radius-control and radius-panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, accordion panels, images. Website only: the app has radius-control and radius-panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero media frame and large promo panels. Website only: the app has radius-control and radius-panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and chips. Utility: rounded-pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on bg. Cards on surface-tint use no shadow. Website only.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover on clickable cards, menus and dialogs. Website only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: App: only what floats (dialogs, menus, popovers, toasts). Content sits on the page with hairlines.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first. Each value is a min-width.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Tablet portrait: 8-column grid, two-up cards.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet landscape and laptop: 12-column grid, full nav, hero goes two-column.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: container reaches max width; gutters stop growing.

layout.note: Container and grid values used by every page template.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width including the grid, centred.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for running text.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height at 960px and up; 64px below.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Website: minimum height of every button, nav item and input. The app uses touch-target.

control.note: App sizes. A touch screen (pointer: coarse) keeps every target at touch-target.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, selects, tabs. Utility: h-control.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: A page's main actions. Utility: h-control-lg.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Dense actions inside a row. Utility: h-control-sm.

tokens.name: control-h-xs
tokens.usage: Smallest inline action. Utility: h-control-xs.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum target on a touch screen. Utility: min-h-touch, variant coarse:.

tokens.name: table-row-max
tokens.usage: The tallest a table row needs to be.
